hardware: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ PRO 395 / Radeon 8060S (laptop; the published 396.1 row came from the desktop gfx1151 Strix Halo host)
purpose: Item 0 of docs/UD-OPTIMIZED-ROUTE-PLAN.md: reconstruct the published prefill protocol and re-measure the plain and UD files under it so before/afters can be quoted honestly.

published_protocol.command: scripts/qwen35_readme_sweep.py --engine gguf --quant gguf_q4_k_s --backend hip_gfx1151 --workloads 512/128 --warmup-runs 1 --measured-runs 3 --warmup-decode-tokens 1 --force-bulk-prefill --bulk-prefill-attention-mode bulk --use-wmma-prefill --use-gemv-decode --graph-replay-decode (plus a prebuild pass with --no-graph-replay-decode)
published_protocol.note: The earlier 160.5 plain-file figure used the resident-session default prefill (no WMMA, no forced bulk attention), explaining the discrepancy with the published row.

plain_Q4_K_S.note: decode reproduces the published protocol (12.56 vs 13.1 desktop); prefill is the zbook floor for this host (desktop publishes 396.1)

limitations: Laptop power/clock variability: gross numbers; the plain/UD ratio is same-host same-protocol and is the quotable comparison.
UD file cannot use the WMMA prefill flags meaningfully today (its tensors are not T16); the flags are applied identically and the fallback serves it.
